text: This report provides an update on the acceleration effort in response to a motion adopted by the Board at its meeting of May 14, 2025. “That the Board direct staff to work with the City Manager, the General Manager, Transportation Services, and the Executive Director, Transit Expansion Division to expedite all required land acquisitions and permits to accelerate construction of the SRT busway and report back in July on the acceleration plan.”
The TTC Board: 1. Forwarded a copy of this report to the City Clerk for submission to the next Scarborough Community Council meeting for information.
